Tests supplement, not replace, general proof.

value.rationale: The 2026 EB method is used for FFT derivatives and explicitly varies continuation parameters. The theorem gives its sharp unavoidable arbitrary-sample noise gain for all legal smooth symmetric blends, separates attainability by continuation parity, and proves d=9,C=64 requires 17,527,209,985-fold worst-case amplification. This guides choosing extrapolation degree/width and interpreting smooth-data numerical success without falsely equating it with stability for perturbed samples.
